verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's own materials name 'automations' and 'Enhanced automations' as product features, and Transactional supports event-driven messages and inbound routes. That points to a first-party automation capability, but the evidence never describes defining trigger rules on events or what actions they can fire. Webhooks only push events outward for your own app to act on, so they are a developer building block and earn no credit. missing for 10: documented event-trigger rule definitions, a catalog of supported trigger events and actions, conditional logic or branching, AI-native rule authoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
